title: Spok Sets Date to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Spok announced it will release its third quarter 2026 operating results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after the close of the U.S. financial markets.
body_markdown:
**Plano, Tx. (Oct. 22, 2026)** – Spok Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: SPOK), a global leader in healthcare communications, today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 operating results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after the close of the U.S. financial markets.


Management will host a conference call and webcast to discuss these financial results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET. The presentation is open to all interested parties and may include forward-looking information.


**Conference Call Details**


Date/Time Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET


Webcast:[https://www.webcast-eqs.com/registration/Spok_Q3_2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.webcast-eqs.com%2Fregistration%2FSpok_Q3_2026&esheet=54626560&newsitemid=20261021273310&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.webcast-eqs.com%2Fregistration%2FSpok_Q3_2026&index=1&md5=dd32f5f12ea0e44c9095d21def2e19eb)


U.S. Toll-Free Dial In:877-407-0890


International Dial In:+1-201-389-0918


To access the call, please dial in approximately ten minutes before the start of the call. For those unable to join the live call, an OnDemand version of the webcast will be available following the call under the URL link and on the investor relations website.


## About Spok


Spok Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: SPOK), headquartered in Plano, Texas, is proud to be a global leader in healthcare communications. We deliver clinical information to care teams when and where it matters most to improve patient outcomes. Top hospitals rely on the Spok Care Connect® platform to enhance workflows for clinicians and support administrative compliance. Our customers send over 65 million messages each month through their Spok® solutions. Spok enables smarter, faster clinical communication.
